About this Event

🪔✨ DIWALI IN THE BAY AREA ✨🪔
A NIGHT OF LIGHTS, CULTURE & DESI GRANDEUR
NACH NACHKE PRESENTS
This Diwali, we’re bringing the magic of India to the Bay Area for a night that celebrates tradition, culture, and unforgettable nightlife! 🪔✨ Get ready to step into a world of golden lights, royal vibes, vibrant energy, and the sounds that bring our community together.
On Saturday, November 7, experience Diwali like never before at ERA LOUNGE — where timeless Indian traditions meet modern nightlife. Expect an atmosphere filled with festive elegance, dazzling lights, beautiful décor, and nonstop Desi music that will keep the dance floor alive all night long.
From Bollywood anthems and Punjabi bangers to your favorite Desi party tracks, we’re bringing you the perfect soundtrack for a celebration full of energy, style, and unforgettable memories. Gather your crew, bring your festive spirit, and get ready for a night worthy of the Festival of Lights! 🔥
👑 TRADITIONAL ATTIRE REQUIRED 👑
Dress to impress. Celebrate your culture. Own the night.
Traditional Indian clothing is REQUIRED FOR ENTRY. Bring out your finest kurta, sherwani, salwar suit, lehenga, saree, or other traditional South Asian attire. Think royal fits, rich colors, elegant embroidery, and festive looks that make a statement.
This is your chance to represent your culture, show off your best traditional looks, and make the entire venue feel like a grand Diwali celebration. ✨
🚨 ERA LOUNGE SELLS OUT — DON’T WAIT! 🚨
If you’ve been to ERA LOUNGE, you know the energy! Events at the lounge have been selling out, and this Diwali celebration is one you don’t want to miss.
